products.name: Olive Twill Overshirt
products.why: Easy to coordinate with everyday outfits, with thoughtful pocket details and a structured collar for a versatile layer.
products.subtitle: Easy layering for everyday wear.
products.description: A relaxed overshirt in olive cotton twill, cut for layering over knitwear. Two chest flap pockets, a full button front and a soft collar.

products.name: Textured Knit Sweater
products.why: A clean crew neck that layers under outerwear and still works on its own.
products.subtitle: Cream textured knit crewneck
products.description: A cream crewneck sweater in a textured cotton knit with ribbed cuffs and hem. Designed as an everyday layer for transitional weather.

products.name: Straight Leg Jeans
products.why: A straightforward straight leg in a dark wash, easy to style with knitwear and overshirts.
products.subtitle: Dark indigo straight-leg jeans
products.description: Straight-leg jeans in dark indigo denim with a mid rise, five-pocket construction and a clean hem.

products.name: The Dream Pant
products.subtitle: Pull-on straight trouser
products.description: A pull-on straight-leg trouser in a soft stretch twill, with a flat front and an easy elastic back.
products.why: The pull-on waist makes it an everyday trouser that still looks polished with a shirt or knit.

products.name: The Perform Legging
products.subtitle: High-rise performance legging
products.description: A high-rise performance legging in a compressive stretch knit with a wide waistband and a clean ankle length.
products.why: An everyday base layer that works under tunics and overshirts, or on its own at the weekend.

products.name: 318 Wide-Leg Corduroy Pants
products.subtitle: Wide-leg corduroy pants
products.description: Wide-leg corduroy pants with a high rise and a clean, floor-skimming leg. A soft cord that holds its shape.
products.why: The wide leg balances a chunky knit or a fitted tee; an easy swap for denim.

products.name: 501 Straight Jeans
products.subtitle: Original straight-leg jeans
products.description: The original straight-leg jean in a mid wash, with a button fly and a clean straight leg from hip to hem.
products.why: A straight leg that works with overshirts, knits and coats; the most reliable everyday denim.

products.name: Faux Wool Long Jacket
products.subtitle: Long button-up wool-blend jacket
products.description: A long, button-up jacket in a faux wool blend with a clean lapel and side pockets. Cut to layer over knitwear.
products.why: A polished layer that still reads everyday; long enough to cover a knit and light enough for transitional weather.

products.name: Paxton Quilted Shirt Jac
products.subtitle: Quilted shirt jacket
products.description: A quilted shirt jacket with a corduroy collar, snap front and patch pockets. Light enough to wear indoors, warm enough for the commute.
products.why: A shirt-jac is the easiest autumn layer: throw it over a flannel or a knit and it works.

products.name: Jolie Cable Sweater
products.subtitle: Cable-knit crewneck sweater
products.description: A chunky cable-knit crewneck in a soft wool blend, with ribbed cuffs and hem. Designed to be worn on its own or layered.
products.why: The cable texture does the work; pair it with straight jeans or a corduroy trouser and stop there.

products.name: Nash Flannel Shirt
products.subtitle: Plaid flannel shirt
products.description: A brushed cotton flannel in a classic plaid, with a full button front and chest pockets. Soft enough to wear open over a tee.
products.why: An overshirt, a shirt and a light layer in one; the plaid adds the only pattern the outfit needs.

products.name: Fleece-Lined Leggings
products.subtitle: Fleece-lined full-length leggings
products.description: Full-length leggings with a brushed fleece lining, a high rise and side pockets. Warm enough for winter commutes.
products.why: The winter base layer that still looks like a legging; wear it under a long coat or a tunic.

products.name: 505 Cord Pants
products.subtitle: Regular-fit corduroy pants
products.description: Regular-fit corduroy pants with a straight leg and a classic five-pocket build. A soft, broken-in cord for everyday wear.
products.why: A cord pant that works with a flannel or a crewneck; warmer than denim without looking dressed up.

products.name: Worker Flannel Shirt
products.subtitle: Classic worker flannel shirt
products.description: A classic worker flannel in a brushed cotton, with a full button front, chest pockets and a relaxed cut.
products.why: The flannel does the layering; wear it open over a tee or buttoned under the sherpa jacket.

products.name: Sherpa Shirt Jac
products.subtitle: Sherpa-lined shirt jacket
products.description: A shirt jacket in a heavy cotton with a sherpa lining, chest pockets and a snap front. Built for cold mornings.
products.why: A warm layer that still looks like a shirt; works over a flannel and under a coat.

products.name: Crewneck Sweater
products.subtitle: Cotton crewneck sweater
products.description: A clean crewneck in a soft cotton knit, with ribbed cuffs and hem. An easy layer under a jacket or on its own.
products.why: The plain crewneck is the most useful knit in a winter wardrobe; it goes with cords, jeans and flannel.

products.name: Relaxed Straight Jeans
products.subtitle: Relaxed straight-leg jeans
products.description: Relaxed straight-leg jeans in a mid-weight denim, with a mid rise and a clean hem. Roomy through the leg without being baggy.
products.why: A relaxed straight leg that fits over boots and works with every layer above it.

products.name: Wool-Blend Coat
products.subtitle: Button-up wool-blend coat
products.description: A single-breasted coat in a wool blend, with a notch lapel, side pockets and a clean knee-length cut.
products.why: A proper winter coat that still works with jeans and a crewneck; the one outer layer for the season.
